# Loading card

> A card standing in for content on its way: skeleton bars, one per line of what is coming.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](../COMPONENTS.md).

## When to use

- Content that takes a moment to arrive, in the place its card will sit.

## When not to use

- Content that is already there: use a Card.
- Nothing to show at all: use the empty state of a Card.
- A failure: use the error state of a Card.

## Alternatives

- **[Card](card.md):** The Card is the finished state. The Loading card holds its place until the content arrives, then the Card replaces it.

## How to use

**Element:** `<div class="card card--loading">` holding `.card-skel` bars and a `.sr-only` "Loading" line.

- Add `.card--loading` to a `.card`.
- Inside it, add one `.card-skel` bar per line of the coming content, each with one size class.
- Add `<span class="sr-only">Loading</span>`, so a screen reader hears what the bars show.

**Classes:** `.card--loading`, `.card-skel`, `.card-skel--media`, `.card-skel--title`, `.card-skel--line`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bar` | modifier class | `media` (`.card-skel--media`), `title` (`.card-skel--title`), `line` (`.card-skel--line`) | None. Required: every `.card-skel` takes one size. | The shape of one skeleton bar. Repeat `.card-skel` once per line of the coming content. |

## Variants

Available bar sizes: `media`, `title`, `line`.

- `media` (`.card-skel--media`): A media block.
- `title` (`.card-skel--title`): A title line.
- `line` (`.card-skel--line`): A line of body copy.

Default bar: None. Required: every `.card-skel` takes one size.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `.card--loading` with no `.card-skel` bars inside | MUST NOT | It renders as an empty box. |
| `.card-skel` with no `bar` size | MUST NOT | The bar has no shape. |
| `.card-skel` outside a `.card--loading` | MUST NOT | The bars are made to sit inside a loading card. |
| `.card--loading` with the `empty` or `error` state of a Card | MUST NOT | A card shows one state at a time. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Passes over it: a loading card is not focusable. |
| Enter, Space | Do nothing: a loading card takes no input. |
| Down arrow in a screen reader's browse mode (VoiceOver: VO + Right arrow) | Reads the `.sr-only` "Loading" line. The skeleton bars are empty boxes, so nothing else is read. |

A loading card holds no controls; its `.sr-only` "Loading" line is what a screen reader hears.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Fill `.card--loading` with `.card-skel` bars, one per line of the content it stands in for. | [Automated: Component-rules lint](../foundations/checks.md#component-rules-lint) |
| MUST | Add `<span class="sr-only">Loading</span>`, so a screen reader hears what the bars show. | [Automated: Component-rules lint](../foundations/checks.md#component-rules-lint) |
| MUST | Stop the shimmer under reduced motion; components.css already does, so keep it when you restyle the bars. | [Automated: Component-rules lint](../foundations/checks.md#component-rules-lint) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Example

```html
<div class="card card--loading">
  <span class="sr-only">Loading</span>
  <div class="card-skel card-skel--media"></div>
  <div class="card-skel card-skel--title"></div>
  <div class="card-skel card-skel--line"></div>
</div>
```

## Look

- **Loading card** is `.card--loading` filled with `.card-skel` bars, one per line of the content it
  stands in for. Without the bars it is an empty box. The shimmer stops under reduced motion.

Values in braces, such as `{colors.border}`, are named on the foundation pages, starting with [Colour](../foundations/color.md); every token with its purpose is on [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md).

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.card--loading` | modifier | skeleton state; fill it with .card-skel bars or it is an empty box | `--space-300` |
| `.card-skel` | base | one skeleton bar inside .card--loading; pair it with a size below | `--alpha-200`, `--brand-ink-rgb`, `--color-surface-sunken`, `--ease-default`, `--radius-sm` |
| `.card-skel--media` | modifier | media-block bar | None |
| `.card-skel--title` | modifier | title bar | None |
| `.card-skel--line` | modifier | body-line bar | None |
